callOutcome.description: Standard does not create calendar bookings.

isEmergency.description: Urgent property damage or safety issue requiring owner review; it does not mean a technician has been dispatched.

serviceType.description: Requested service, such as AC repair, furnace issue, or plumbing leak. Empty if not captured.

isInterested.description: True only if the caller clearly wants service or follow-up.

appointmentRequested.description: True if the caller requests scheduling follow-up. This is not a confirmed appointment.

issueDescription.description: Factual issue description in the customer's own words.

preferredTimeWindow.description: Requested time window, not a booking confirmation.

additionalNotes.description: Relevant customer-provided context only; avoid unnecessary sensitive data.

serviceLocation.description: Location as caller said it; Unknown if not provided.
